title: Jan Vishwas Bill 2022 introduced
detail: Introduced in Lok Sabha and referred to a Joint Parliamentary Committee the same day. Amends 42 laws, converting several fines into penalties that do not need court prosecution and removing imprisonment for many offences.

title: Joint Parliamentary Committee reports on Jan Vishwas Bill 2022
detail: Committee report presented before the Bill was taken up for passing.

title: Jan Vishwas Bill 2022 passed by Parliament
detail: Passed by Lok Sabha on 27 July 2023 and Rajya Sabha on 2 August 2023. 42 central Acts amended.

title: Jan Vishwas Bill 2025 introduced
detail: Sought to amend 17 central Acts; referred to a Select Committee of Lok Sabha (Chair: Tejasvi Surya).

title: Select Committee reports on Jan Vishwas Bill 2025
detail: Recommended further changes to the 17 Acts and amendments to 65 other Acts.

title: Jan Vishwas Bill 2025 withdrawn
detail: Withdrawn to make way for a wider Bill reflecting the Select Committee's recommendations.

title: Jan Vishwas Bill 2026 introduced
detail: Introduced in Lok Sabha to amend 80 central Acts, decriminalising or rationalising offences and penalties. Passed by Lok Sabha on 1 April and Rajya Sabha on 2 April 2026.

title: Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Act, 2026 (No. 8 of 2026)
detail: Presidential assent on 7 April 2026, published in the Gazette of India on 8 April. Comes into force on dates the Centre notifies, which may differ for each Act in the Schedule: watch for commencement notifications.
source: Gazette of India (Extraordinary) Part II Section 1
